程序包 org.springframework.batch.item.database

接口 PagingQueryProvider

所有已知实现类:
AbstractSqlPagingQueryProvider, Db2PagingQueryProvider, DerbyPagingQueryProvider, H2PagingQueryProvider, HanaPagingQueryProvider, HsqlPagingQueryProvider, MariaDBPagingQueryProvider, MySqlPagingQueryProvider, OraclePagingQueryProvider, PostgresPagingQueryProvider, SqlitePagingQueryProvider, SqlServerPagingQueryProvider, SybasePagingQueryProvider
public interface PagingQueryProvider
Interface defining the functionality to be provided for generating paging queries for use with Paging Item Readers.
